definitions.explanation: A camera installed to monitor and record activity for crime prevention and security purposes.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}には{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラが{設置|せっち}されている。
examples.english: This store has security cameras installed.

examples.japanese: {防犯|ぼうはん}カメラの{映像|えいぞう}で{犯人|はんにん}が{特定|とくてい}された。
examples.english: The culprit was identified from the security camera footage.

examples.japanese: {防犯|ぼうはん}カメラ{作動中|さどうちゅう}。

notes:
COMPOSITION: {防犯|ぼうはん} (crime prevention) + カメラ (camera).

SYNONYMS:
- {監視|かんし}カメラ: surveillance camera (emphasizes monitoring)
- CCTV: closed-circuit television

COMMON LOCATIONS:
- {店舗|てんぽ}: stores
- {駅|えき}: train stations
- コンビニ: convenience stores
- {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}: parking lots
- {住宅街|じゅうたくがい}: residential areas
- {銀行|ぎんこう}: banks

SIGNAGE:
- {防犯|ぼうはん}カメラ{作動中|さどうちゅう} (security cameras in operation)
- {録画中|ろくがちゅう} (recording in progress)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {防犯|ぼうはん}: crime prevention
- {監視|かんし}: surveillance, monitoring
- {映像|えいぞう}: footage, video
- {録画|ろくが}: recording
- {画像解析|がぞうかいせき}: image analysis
